issues.title: Live production domain blocks every crawler and is noindex on all 111 pages
evidence: curl https://www.niramayclinics.com/robots.txt -> `User-Agent: *` / `Disallow: /` (no Sitemap line)
curl -D - https://www.niramayclinics.com/diabetes/ -> `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` (111/111 pages)
raw HTML: `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"/>` on 46 pages (all non-blog pages)
app/layout.tsx:36 bakes `robots:{index:false}` at BUILD time; app/robots.ts has no `dynamic` export so it is also build-time static
issues.fix: When the client approves launch: (1) set SITE_INDEXABLE=true for the Vercel Production environment only (keep Preview unset so previews stay noindex via proxy.ts); (2) remove SITE_PASSWORD from Production; (3) make app/robots.ts request-time (`export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`) and drop the build-baked robots meta from app/layout.tsx so the header in proxy.ts is the single switch; (4) redeploy and verify with curl: robots.txt shows `Allow: /` + `Sitemap:`, no X-Robots-Tag, no meta robots.
issues.local_fix: code fixed: force-dynamic robots, request-time X-Robots-Tag, no build-baked noindex; REMAINING: set SITE_INDEXABLE=true in Vercel Production
